Kohhran lo din chhoh dan leh \han zel dan: Sihphir Kohhran Committee chuan Pi Hauchhungi leh a faten Rev. D.E. Jones (Zosaphluia) kuta Baptisma an chan ni December ni 25, 1910 chu Sihphir Kohhran din \an niah pawmin, kum 2010 khan Kohhran Centenary theih ang tawka ropuiin a lo lawm tawh a. Mizorama Kohhran upa pawl takte zingah telin Kohhran \hang duang leh Pathian malsawmna dawng tak Kohhran a ni zui a. Rawngbawltu eng emaw zat leh Kohhran dang hringtu pawimawh tak a ni a. Sihphir Kohhran a\ang hian Kohhran pathum Sihphir Vengthar (1967), Sihphir Hmarveng (1989) bakah Sihphir Venglai (1991) Kohhran-te an in dang tawh a. Kum 1961 a\angin Pastor \hutchilh Kohhran niin, Pastor bial pawh Mizoramah hmasa pawlte zinga mi a ni bawk.

Kohhran In-te: Sihphir Kohhran Biak In hmasa ber chu Arpu Vengah, tuna Pu PC. Thanbanglova In (SBI in an luah) ah hian sak a ni a. Kohhrana rawngbawltu dinhmun: Sihphir Kohhran Upa hmasa ber te chu - Khamngova, Laipawnga leh Sikhuma te niin 1912 October ni 5-ah nemngheh an ni a (Synod Thurel lakkhawm Volume I page 70). Kum 2025 thleng hian Kohhran Upa neih tawh zat chu 40 niin tunah hian active Upa 14 leh Tual Upa 6 an awm mek.

Tualchhunga hmalakna lian zualte: Kristian Chhungkua, Sunday School, Social Front etc. te hmalakna bakah Tualchhung lama hmalakna chhuanawm tak pakhat chu - Pathianni apiangin mi harsa \ anpui nan bawm dawh \hin niin, chumi tling khawm hmang chuan in hmun nei si, sakna tur sum nei lo, in pathum ngawt sak tawh niin, in pakhat sa leh turin ruahmanna kalpui mek a ni a. Kohhran mipuite he rawngbawlna ah hian an phur tlang hle.

Kum 2014 a\angin Presbyterian English School dinin, tunah hian Class VIII thleng hawn tawh a ni a. Zirtirtu 13-in zirlai 245 an enkawl mek a. Kohhran hma lam hun atan rawngbawltu leh kohhran mi chher chhuahna pawimawh tak a nih zui ngei kan beisei.

Synod Inkhawmpuiin Kohhran te leh harsa dawm chhuah ni se a tih kalpuiin Sihphir Kohhran in a enkawl chu Damdep II Branch Church a ni a. Biak In \hutthleng leh Sound System te leisakin, theih ang tawkin a enkawl mek.

Rawngbawltu \hut chilh tawhtute: Synod rawngbawltu pawimawh engemaw zatin Sihphir Kohhran hi an \hutchilh tawh \hin a. Kohhran leh a hnuaia Committee hrang hrangte : Kohhran rawngbawlna tichak a, a bika hma la turin Kohhran Committee hnuaiah pawl hrang hrang din a ni a. Kohhran Hmeichhia: Kohhran din rualin Kohhran Hmeichhia hi a ding ve nghal em tih hriat theih ni lo mah se hruaitu hmasate hriat danin kum 1949 vel khan Kohhran Hmeichhia hi ding tawh ngeiin hriat a ni a. A hranin inkhawmte pawh an lo nei tawh thin a, Committee-te pawh an lo \hu tawh \hin a. Kohhran rawngbawlna tichaktu pawimawh tak niin kum 2025 hian Member 771 an ni mek.

Kristian |halai Pawl: Kum 1951-ah \halaite a hranin an lo inkhawm tawh \hin tih Kohhran record a\angin hmuh tur a awm a. Kum 1955 March 19-ah Branch K|P hminga lo ding \anin rawngbawlna kawngah an thawh hlawk hle a. Kohhran tana chakna hnar pawimawh tak an lo ni chho ta a. An thil tum ang ngeiin Kohhran kut ke pawimawh tak an ni mek a. Kum 2025-ah hian Member 640 an awm mek.

Kohhran Pavalai Pawl: Kum 2013, February ni 23-ah Kohhran Pavalai Pawl hi din tan a ni a. Hmun remchang danga eng emaw chen an inkhawm hnuin Ni 15 May 2014 a\angin Biak Inah an inkhawm \an a. Kohhran-in a beisei ang ngeiin rawngbawlna nung takin an kalpui mek a. Kum 2025 hian Member 187 an awm mek.

Masihi Sangati: Kum 1988 a\angin hnam dang zinga rawngbawlna hi kalpui a lo ni tawh a. Hnam dangte zinga rawngbawlnaah hian tha thawh nasa leh thawh hlawk hmasa pawl tak kohhran niin, Zaipawl pawh hun rei tawh tak a\ang khan neih a ni tawh a. Ram pum huap Convention hi \um hnih Sihphir Kohhran Biak Inah hian nghah a lo ni tawh a. Kar tin Zirtawpni zan apiangin Masihi Sangati-te hi an inkhawm \hin a ni.
